Subject: Redwood: Pen test summary & vulnerability management process

Hi Alice / Bob —

Thanks for sharing the SOC2 and exec summary. As promised, attaching a redacted summary of Redwood's most recent independent pen test and our vulnerability management/ disclosure artifacts. High-level points below: 

- Pen test: Independent external test completed Aug 2025 by RedTeamSec. We are sharing a redacted summary; the full technical report can be provided under an NDA. See attachment: redwood_pen_test_summary_2025.pdf.

- Vulnerability management: severity categories and target SLAs: Critical — 24 hours; High — 72 hours; Medium — 14 days; Low — next patch. We run continuous internal scans (weekly), external dynamic scans monthly, and quarterly third-party assessments. We also maintain an open (vetted) bug bounty program for critical assets.

- Third-party integrations & ownership: For integrations where Redwood hosts customer workloads, Redwood owns patching of our infra and runtime. Customer-managed integrations (self-hosted connectors) are the customer's responsibility; we document recommended patch windows and provide configuration hardening guides. If a vulnerability impacts both parties, we coordinate remediation with agreed timelines and joint communication.

- Disclosure & responsible reporting: We follow coordinated disclosure. Our policy (attached: vuln_disclosure_policy.txt) outlines triage, acknowledgement windows (48 hours), and public disclosure timelines. 

Next steps: 
1) Sharing attachments (redacted) with this thread.
2) Marissa — happy to join a 30-min technical sync next week to walk through any questions.
3) If you’d like the full pen test under NDA, we can provision that quickly — let me know.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Lead Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments:

 - vuln_disclosure_policy.txt
